retrodiction.quote: build the panel from data vintages available at time T, project forward, and score against realized outcomes at T+k

pseudo_vintage.quote: pre-registry history is a reconstruction problem -- survey redesigns, revised administrative tables, re-released panels -- so the protocol grades pre-registry backtests as pseudo-vintage, with a published log of deviations from true vintage, and no registry pins specification leakage: a "2005-vintage" model built today knows 2008 happened, and the protocol says so

deviation_log.quote: a published log of deviations from true vintage
deviation_log.operationalization: this artifact publishes TWO deviation logs, because the paper's sentence names two distinct deviations. (1) deviation_log_vintage_revision: every cell-year where the earlier and later SSA publications of the same fact disagree -- the 'revised administrative tables' clause, MEASURED. (2) deviation_log_specification_leakage: the ways a T*-refit built today is not a true T* vintage -- the 'knows 2008 happened' clause, ENUMERATED with a deviation class and a consequence per entry. A retrodiction score is conditional on both.

deviation_classes.true_vintage_artifact: the fit source is an artifact published at or before the vintage boundary whose content cannot contain post-boundary information (6.B5.1 as printed in the 2014 Supplement). Strongest available class.
deviation_classes.true_vintage_artifact_partial: a true pre-boundary artifact used at an origin EARLIER than its own publication, so its rows are settled-but-not-contemporaneous printings.
deviation_classes.immutable_series_single_vintage: one post-boundary artifact, but the fit rows are final when made and not revisable, so no VALUE leakage; specification leakage remains.
deviation_classes.revisable_series_single_vintage: one post-boundary artifact whose fit rows may have been revised with post-boundary information. Not gate-eligible.
deviation_classes.specification_leakage_unpinned: unmeasurable by construction; named, never priced. Applies to the whole arm.

protocol.T_star_rationale: the last SETTLED entitlement row of the 2014 printing. T* is a DATA-CONTENT cutoff and sits one year inside the vintage AVAILABILITY cutoff, because the 2013 row the 2014 Supplement printed was provisional -- see settlement_analysis.

excluded_years.2013: provisional terminal row of the FIT vintage; neither trusted as fit input nor scored as a clean holdout
excluded_years.2022: provisional terminal row of the RESOLUTION vintage; a moving target

protocol.shock_window_rule: gate_m6 partitions 2020-2022 out of every gated set as exogenous_shock_outside_model_class and publishes it as a diagnostic. The same discipline binds here: shock years are measured and reported separately and enter no pooled baseline.
protocol.rolling_origin_rationale: the REGISTERED origin T*=2012 yields one projection per horizon and therefore no dispersion. Rolling the origin back over the fit vintage's settled rows supplies the replications the seeds 0-4 blocks summarize. Every rolling origin fits only rows at or before itself.

settlement_analysis.finding: the two 6.B5.1 printings do not disagree diffusely. They disagree in exactly one regime: the TERMINAL entitlement row of the earlier printing, which is still accruing late-posted awards when its Supplement goes to press. Settled rows are reproduced to the printed digit.
settlement_analysis.mechanism_quoted_from_the_table: The data in this table differ from those in table 6.B5 because awards are summarized here by the year in which entitlement began rather than by the year the award action was posted on the Master Beneficiary Record.

independent_confirmation.what: the same signature at the OTHER end of the panel and from a DIFFERENT table. Table 6.A1 counts retired-worker awards by award action; 6.B5.1 counts them by entitlement year. Over settled years the two agree closely; at the 2023 vintage's own terminal row the gap jumps, because 6.B5.1's terminal row is short the late-posted awards that 6.A1 already has.

protocol_consequences: the provisional terminal row of the FIT vintage (2013) is excluded from the fit window, so T* = 2012 even though the vintage availability boundary is 2014
the provisional terminal row of the RESOLUTION vintage (2022) is excluded from the scored window, which therefore ends at 2021
the vintage-revision floor is partitioned by settlement status; pooling the two regimes produces a tolerance driven entirely by one provisional row

floor_design.person_disjoint_unavailable_in_principle: gate_1 / gate_2 / gate_2b / gate_2c / gate_m4 / gate_m6 price a PERSON-DISJOINT half-split floor because their truth side is a SAMPLE: two disjoint halves of the source frame are two independent realizations of one estimand. The retrodiction arm's truth side is an administrative CENSUS -- SSA's own note on 6.B5.1 reads 'Master Beneficiary Record, 100 percent data (not a sample)'. There is no sampling frame to split, so a person-disjoint floor is unavailable IN PRINCIPLE, not merely unbuilt, and a bootstrap over published shares would invent a variance the source does not have.
floor_design.vintage_disjoint_is_the_analogue: the analogue that preserves the meaning -- two independent realizations of one estimand differing only through the measurement process -- is the pair of PUBLICATION VINTAGES of the same table cell. The repository holds one genuine pair: Table 6.B5.1 as printed in the 2014 Supplement and as reprinted in the 2023 Supplement. Disjointness is STRUCTURAL (two separate publications), which is stronger than the seeded disjointness of a half-split, not weaker.
floor_design.seed_semantics: seeds 0-4 index five DISJOINT stride-5 blocks of the replication units, not RNG draws. For F1 a unit is a SETTLED publication year in the two-vintage overlap; for F2 it is a pseudo-vintage ORIGIN. Blocks are disjoint and exhaustive, so the across-seed sd is the between-block dispersion of the estimate -- the quantity round(mean + k*sd, 3) is meant to price. A deterministic exhaustive partition replaces a random one because the replication units are YEARS: they are ordered and trending, so a random split would make block composition, not the measurement process, the dominant source of across-seed variance.

three_quantities.F0_publication_rounding: half the printed granularity. A share printed to one decimal cannot be resolved below +/-0.05 pp. Exact, deterministic, and a hard lower bound on every other floor.
three_quantities.F1_vintage_revision: the VINTAGE-DISJOINT measurement floor: |value in vintage A - value in vintage B| for the same (cell, year), computed on SETTLED rows only. It is DEGENERATE for this arm -- see settlement_analysis -- and that degeneracy is the finding, not a failure of the measurement.
three_quantities.F2_naive_baseline: NOT a floor. The skill CEILING: what the information-null rules (persistence, linear trend) achieve on exactly this protocol. A tolerance at or above it certifies nothing, because a rule carrying no information past T* already passes.

floor_design.skill_window_rule: DRAFT: a cell is gate-eligible only if a tolerance fits STRICTLY between max(F0, the F1-derived instrument) and F2. A cell whose measurement floor already meets what the naive rule achieves has no room for skill and is report-only. This is the retrodiction-arm analogue of gate_2's min_events_for_gate = 20 and gate_m6's ln(1.5) power cap.

deviation_log_vintage_revision.definition: every (cell, year) where the 2014 and 2023 Supplement printings of Table 6.B5.1 disagree, tagged by settlement regime. This is the 'revised administrative tables' half of the deviation log gate_3's description requires.

deviation_log_specification_leakage.definition: the 'a 2005-vintage model built today knows 2008 happened' half. These deviations from TRUE vintage are NAMED, not measured -- naming them is what 'pseudo-vintage' means, and a retrodiction score is conditional on the whole list.

entries.detail: every module specification in this repository was chosen after 2014-2022 was observable. A T*-refit re-estimates PARAMETERS on <=T* data, but its STRUCTURE was selected with the holdout visible. gate_m6 carries this exact disclosure for its own surface (not_certified.spec_selection_in_sample).
entries.consequence: a retrodiction PASS is conditional on this; it may never be stated as an unconditional out-of-sample result

entries.detail: the cells in this artifact, the naive rules, T*, the shock partition and the exclusion of provisional terminal rows were all chosen in 2026 with 2014-2022 in hand. The settlement finding in particular was DISCOVERED from the vintage pair, not pre-registered.
entries.consequence: pre-registration of the arm happens at the lock ceremony, on this artifact; nothing here is itself pre-registered

entries.detail: the covered-earnings (Supplement 2025 Table 4.B11) and disability (DI ASR 2023) series are read as REVISED today, not as printed at T*. A true-vintage score would use the edition on the shelf at T*. floor_vintage_revision measures the size of that substitution for the ONE family where both printings are held; for the others it is UNMEASURED.
entries.consequence: these families are report-only in this artifact; a second staged printing would promote them

entries.detail: the rolling pseudo-vintage origins 2004-2011 fit rows as printed in the 2014 Supplement, not as printed in the Supplement of that origin year. By the settlement finding those rows were already settled by 2014, so the substitution is expected to be value-free -- but the repository holds no pre-2014 printing with which to verify it.
entries.consequence: the REGISTERED origin T*=2012 uses only rows the 2014 printing genuinely carried; the rolling origins supply dispersion and inherit this unverified substitution

entries.detail: the PSID waves the engine fits are the current public releases, which incorporate post-T* corrections and re-releases. The repository pins file digests, not release dates contemporaneous with T*.
entries.consequence: applies to any candidate run on this arm, not to the truth side priced here

entries.detail: populace_dynamics.claiming._resolve_year snaps an out-of-range entitlement year to the nearest covered year, so a T*-refit that reads claiming shares through the module projects them by holding the last covered row constant. The module's claiming projection IS the persistence rule. A candidate that simply calls it would score EXACTLY the naive baseline, by construction, and must not be graded as skill. runs/claiming_reference_v1.json already measured this rule out of sample within one vintage (fit 1998-2019, predict 2020-2022: nearest-year max abs deviation 3.2 pp vs linear-trend 8.1623 pp).
entries.consequence: the ceremony must require a candidate to declare whether its claiming path is behavioural or carried, and grade a carried path as baseline, not as skill

entries.detail: benefit levels past T* depend on the COLA and the average wage index. A T*-refit that reads realized post-T* COLAs is leaking; one that assumes the T*-vintage Trustees path is not. tr2014_official_baseline.what_it_is: the official forecaster's own pseudo-vintage-2014 retrodiction. The 2014 OASDI Trustees Report (published 2014-07-28) projected combined OASI+DI assets at end of year under intermediate assumptions; the realized values are printed in the Annual Statistical Supplement, 2025, Table 4.A3. This is the strongest available external reference for what deviation an established projection system achieves on this arm at the same vintage boundary gate_m6 refits on.

realized.table_title: Combined Old-Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI) and Disability Insurance (DI) Trust Funds: Receipts, expenditures, and assets
realized.table_bound_by: CAPTION, not header shape: Tables 4.A1 (OASI only) and 4.A2 (DI only) print an identical header row in the same document, so header matching alone selects OASI and silently compares a combined-fund forecast against an OASI-only realization

DRAFT GATE-3 RETRODICTION-ARM EVIDENCE -- PRE-LOCK, NOT RATIFIED.

This is the pre-lock evidence package for the gate_3 retrodiction arm, built the way runs/gate2_floors_v1.json was built before gate 2 locked. It changes no locked value, no model reads it, and it edits no line of gates.yaml. gate_3 stands at locked: false with no thresholds and stays there until a full lock ceremony runs: these floors -> thresholds with machine-bound derivations -> an adversarial referee round -> verification -> maintainer ratification by merge.

STATISTIC. Per cell, the published administrative value for an entitlement or calendar year, and a candidate's pseudo-vintage projection of the same concept built only from information available at T*. Shares and ages are scored as an absolute deviation in published units; counts, ratios and rates as the absolute log ratio.

THE CENTRAL FINDING. The vintage pair does not disagree diffusely; it disagrees in exactly one regime. Settled rows reproduce to the printed digit -- 1 of 240 share cell-years differs, by one granularity unit -- while every share in the provisional terminal row moves, by up to 1.1 pp. So the truth side of this arm carries NO measurable noise once provisional rows are excluded, and the gate-2 tolerance instrument, round(F1_mean + k*F1_sd, 3), degenerates onto the publication-rounding floor.

TWO INSTRUMENTS, NEITHER ASSERTED. Instrument A is that gate-2 tolerance, committed so the ceremony can see the established convention degenerate here rather than take this artifact's word for it. Instrument B is the skill ratio rho against the pre-registered naive baseline, taken PER HORIZON at the registered origin -- the discipline paper/paper.qmd already imposes on resolving cells, and the only form that prices a FORWARD-PROJECTION gate, since the naive baseline's error grows monotonically with horizon. This artifact RECOMMENDS instrument B and DECIDES nothing; the referee round chooses the instrument and fixes its constant, exactly as gate 2's k was fixed.

GATE-ELIGIBLE VS REPORT-ONLY. DRAFT eligibility needs five non-empty vintage blocks, at least 10 settled overlap years, at least 5 pseudo-vintage origins, a scale-invariant statistic (level cells are not gate-eligible pre-W1: the ratified anchor-context design publishes 'only the scale-invariant comparisons authorized below', and this repository's frame is not nationalized), and room for skill. Every cell failing any of these carries its blocking reasons in cell_stability.

WHAT THIS PACKAGE DOES NOT DO. It scores no candidate, prices no model-side noise, and certifies nothing. The not_computable register names every gap and what would close it.

horizon_monotonicity.status: MEASURED FINDING AND AN OPEN REFEREE QUESTION
horizon_monotonicity.finding: horizon growth is a POPULATION property, not a per-cell law. Pooled across the eligible cells the naive baseline rises monotonically with horizon, but individual cells split: cells whose published share trends (age62, age66, age67_69, age70plus, average age) grow with horizon, while cells whose share is flat or mean-reverting (age64, age65, disability_conversion) do NOT.
horizon_monotonicity.referee_question: under instrument B the tolerance inherits the baseline's shape, so for the decreasing cells the DRAFT tolerance is TIGHTER at h=7 than at h=2. That is defensible -- the naive rule really is more accurate there, so beating it is a harder test -- but it is the opposite of what a reader of a 'forward projection' gate will expect. The ceremony must decide explicitly: take the shape as measured, or require a non-decreasing envelope (tolerance(h) = rho * max over h' <= h of the baseline). Both are computable from what is committed here; this artifact takes neither.

reproducibility: no wall clock and no environment block are written into this artifact, so re-running the builder on the same committed inputs reproduces it byte for byte. The measurement environment lives in the .env.json sidecar and the source digests in .inputs.json, the convention runs/tenure_floors_v1.json established. tests/test_gate3_retrodiction_floors.py rebuilds and compares rather than only pinning a digest.
